## User Remediation Guidance
> **Plain-Language Remediation**:  
> Ensure the caller address is in the configured oracle publisher list before calling submit_oracle_time.

---

## Reproduction

The following test code triggers this error condition:

```rust
let f = Fixture::setup_quiet();
let pub1 = Address::generate(&f.env);
let unauthorized = Address::generate(&f.env);
let mut pubs = soroban_sdk::Vec::new(&f.env);
pubs.push_back(pub1);
f.client.mock_all_auths().set_oracle_config(&f.governor, &pubs, &1, &3600);
let now = f.env.ledger().timestamp();
rejected!(f.client.mock_all_auths().try_submit_oracle_time(&unauthorized, &now));
```
